How I work

How a project with me runs

You always know what is happening, what it costs and when it lands.

  1. 01

    Tell me what you need

    Message me on WhatsApp or email, and we talk it through. You get a straight answer on whether I'm the right person for it.

  2. 02

    A written plan and price

    Scope, price and timeline in writing before any work starts, so there are no surprises later.

  3. 03

    Progress you can click

    You get a live link early and watch the product grow, with an update every week.

  4. 04

    Launch and handover

    Deployed and running, with documentation and everything you need to keep it going.

  • Built for your real usersSwahili or English, everyday phones, slow networks. The apps above are made for real conditions.
  • Everything written downDecisions, guides and runbooks come with the work. The IRCA system ships with 57 recorded design decisions.
  • One person, the whole productDesign, front end, back end, database and deployment, with no hand-offs between contractors.

About

Hi, I'm Allord.

I'm a full-stack developer. I take a project from the first conversation to something people use every day: the screens, the API underneath, the database and the deploy that puts it live.

Most of my client work is business systems: money that needs approving, members who need managing, people who need registering. I also build my own products, from a church presentation app to a file-transfer engine in Rust, which keeps me sharp across web, Android and desktop.

I started out writing C++ for microcontrollers. That's where I learned to care about performance, edge cases and code someone else can read.

  • Based inTanzania, UTC+3
  • Works inEnglish and Swahili
  • Builds forWeb, Android, Windows, Linux
  • Core stackTypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, Flutter, Python, PostgreSQL
